# Example Trainer Completion Report

## Assumptions

Business-user audience; one-day instructor-led delivery; Microsoft 365 Copilot license and synthetic data are available but not live-verified.

## Source map

Current Microsoft Learn course and supplied trainer-guide/change-log references recorded in the source ledger.

## Objectives

Learners choose an appropriate Copilot surface, write a grounded prompt, verify output, and complete one cross-app workflow.

## Agenda

Introduction, foundation, Chat, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, Excel, Outlook, checks, discussion, and close with recorded timing assumptions.

## Activity and demo map

Weak-to-strong prompt exercise, cross-app demo, review checkpoints, and a no-live-system fallback.

## Lab requirements

Synthetic files, OneDrive, license, permissions, setup, expected results, reset, and cleanup documented.

## Assessment plan

Scenario checks with answer rationale and a learner artifact.

## Accessibility notes

Captions, readable slides, alt text, keyboard path, and non-live alternatives provided.

## Risks and fallbacks

Tenant rollout or feature availability may differ; use screenshots and conceptual walkthroughs.

## Deliverables

Agenda, instructor guide, deck notes, lab runbook, checks, source ledger, and handoff packet.

## Verification evidence

`source`, `static`, `local_rehearsal`, `live`, and `unverified` labels used explicitly.
